title: Tools
description: Every Elffuss tool: remove backgrounds, read text, detect objects, depth maps and videos from a photo, in your browser.
intro: Small tools that work in your browser. Each one downloads its model the first time and keeps it in this browser.
apps.source: The Elffuss apps, as elffuss.com describes them.
install.why: It opens in its own window, and the browser keeps the tools’ models saved instead of clearing them after a few days without use.
